notes: 24h workload inventory for compressed real-eval replay. Fixed-fee accounting uses the 8h compressed replay duration for non-overridden subscriptions. MiniMax Plus quota tier is enforced locally as the real 4500 requests per 5h window and physically sent through OpenRouter's official Minimax provider to avoid consuming a shared native MiniMax subscription account. Fallback API pool keeps eight OpenRouter API providers; AtlasCloud replaces OR_Minimax to avoid duplicate Minimax roles, and AkashML replaces Nebius after OpenRouter removed the Nebius endpoint for MiniMax-M2.5.
